title: Rider Onboarding Associate I2 Manchester - (6 Months Secondment)
description: *Urgent Hiring - Interviews will take place within the next 1-2 weeks * Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you. We’re looking for a Rider Onboarding Associate to join our UKI team. This is a remote role with significant field-based travel, with positions available across Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, and London. In this role, you’ll work directly on the ground to source and onboard riders, ensuring our marketplace always has the right supply to meet customer demand. Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be joining the Rider Enablement team. We focus on building the foundation of our marketplace by managing rider supply across the United Kingdom and Ireland, directly tackling logistics and scaling challenges to keep our fleet well-resourced. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: Deliver in-person onboarding: Travel across the UKI to lead face-to-face rider onboarding sessions and support operations within our regional Rider Onboarding Hubs. Secure hyper-local supply: Target and resolve rider supply deficits in historically hard-to-source areas to maintain fleet consistency. Manage seasonal demand: Execute targeted supply plans for peak and seasonal trading periods to stay ahead of customer and partner requirements. Optimise onboarding processes: Partner with the Supply and Rider Onboarding teams to iterate processes, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and refine demand forecasting. Enhance the rider experience: Collaborate with the Content & Engagement team to improve the rider value proposition and act as the subject matter expert for onboarding systems. What You’ll Need to Thrive Essential Operational capability: Proven experience within a fast-paced environment such as technology, start-ups, food delivery, or direct experience as a Deliveroo Rider. Autonomy and adaptability: A self-starter mindset with the ability to work solo, use your own initiative, and adapt quickly to changing field conditions and priorities. Stakeholder communication: Strong empathetic listening and communication skills, with the ability to influence diverse internal teams and external rider applicants. Logistical flexibility: A valid UKI driving licence and a willingness to travel extensively, including early mornings and late evenings, to support field operations. Nice to Have Language skills: Professional proficiency in Portuguese or Arabic. Technical tooling: Familiarity with G Suite, Slack, Looker, and Salesforce. Note: This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) with the possibility of extension. All travel, mileage, and accommodation expenses incurred while in the field will be fully covered by the company. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you! title: Director of Systems Delivery
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times , and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab. Functions of the Role As Director of Systems Delivery , you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments. We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory ; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements. Full-Stack System Execution : Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover. Cross-Functional Alignment : Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs. Site Infrastructure Readiness : Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment. Acceptance Testing & Governance : Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols. Service & Operational Handoff : Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime. Process Standardisation : Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. Supply Chain Management : Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines. Commercial Scoping Support : Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability. Experience - Essentials Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times. Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints. Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams. Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models. Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols. Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting. Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement. Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required. Experience - Desirable Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures. Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware. Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals. Benefits Be part of a creative, world-leading team Competitive salary and share options scheme Contributory pension scheme Group private medical insurance scheme Life Assurance Cycle-to-work Scheme Central London location EEO Statement Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010. Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Senior Social Commerce Strategist needed on a permanent basis to join our Global Social Commerce Team.</h3> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>The opportunity</h3> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive social media strategies focused on commerce that unify paid and organic efforts to drive measurable results for our clients. creative, and marketing teams to develop engaging and innovative content strategies that resonate with target audiences and drive online shopper experiences.</li> <li><strong>Platform Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Maintain a deep understanding of social media platforms, best practices, and emerging trends, and leverage this knowledge to develop innovative and effective strategies.</li> overall marketing efforts.</li> <li><strong>Client Location Work:</strong>&nbsp;Willingness to work at client locations as needed.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What we want from you</h3> <ul> desirable. raw.description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Omaze is a subscription-first fundraising platform with over 1.2 million active subscribers. We run large-scale prize draws that change people's lives — and we need flawless payments infrastructure behind every one. This role is the operational heartbeat of that infrastructure: owning reconciliation, dunning, vendor relationships, and the day-to-day health of our payments ecosystem. Looking for someone immediately available.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

CORE PAYMENTS OPS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor payment success rates, failure trends, and processor health dashboards daily

  • Investigate and resolve payment exceptions, chargebacks, and disputes end-to-end

  • Own the subscriber payment lifecycle from authorisation through to settlement

  • Manage refund workflows and ensure timely, accurate processing

  • Maintain internal runbooks and escalation protocols for payment incidents

DUNNING & RECOVERY

Failed Payment Recovery

  • Own and continuously optimise the full dunning cycle — retry logic, timing, and messaging

  • Analyse decline reason codes and apply segmented retry strategies accordingly

  • Collaborate with CRM and Product to improve pre-dunning communications

  • Test and iterate dunning cadences using A/B frameworks where available

RECONCILIATION

Financial Accuracy

  • Run daily and monthly reconciliation across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions at 1.2M-subscriber scale

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between processor reports and internal records

  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation tooling in partnership with Engineering or BI

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

Stripe & Shopify

  • Serve as the primary internal owner for both Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions relationships

  • Manage configuration, feature adoption, account health, and platform update impact assessments across Stripe and Shopify Subscriptions

  • Lead regular vendor reviews and negotiate on SLAs, fees, and product roadmap alignment

  • Evaluate alternative or complementary payment tools as the business scales

REPORTING & INSIGHT

Performance Intelligence

  • Produce weekly and monthly payments performance report for Finance and leadership, covering reconciliation sign-off, authorisation rates, payment-failure churn, recovery performance, and net revenue recovered

  • Maintain a payment ops dashboard that gives real-time visibility to key stakeholders

  • Surface actionable insight from decline and recovery data to inform product, CRM, and commercial decisions

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL

Collaboration & Compliance

  • Partner with Product to shape payment-related feature development and releases

  • Support compliance with PCI-DSS requirements and internal data handling policies

  • Brief Customer Support on payment issues affecting member experience

🤩 About You

  • Experience in a payments, fintech, or subscription operations role

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe, including billing, radar, and reporting APIs

  • Proven ownership of a dunning or failed-payment recovery programme

  • Experience running reconciliation at scale (>100k transactions/month)

  • Strong data skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets

  • Ability to read and interpret processor reporting and settlement files

  • Excellent attention to detail and a low tolerance for unexplained discrepancies

  • Clear written communicator able to brief both technical and non-technical audiences

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO'LL THRIVE HERE

  • Relentlessly precise. At 1.2 million subscribers, small error rates become big numbers fast. You're the person who notices the discrepancy everyone else missed and doesn't rest until it's explained.

  • Recovery-minded. You don't just run the dunning process — you obsess over why cards fail, segment your retries intelligently, and find percentage points of recovery others leave behind.

  • A confident vendor partner. You build strong relationships with Stripe and Shopify account teams, know how to escalate effectively, and hold vendors accountable to SLAs without burning bridges.

  • Process-builder, not just process-follower. You inherit some workflows and build others from scratch. You're comfortable creating runbooks, automating repetitive checks, and leaving things better than you found them.

  • Clear under pressure. When a payment incident lands at pace, you triage fast, communicate clearly to Finance and leadership, and resolve it without drama.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

services.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Professional Services Sales and Customer Outcomes in the EMEA region.</p> <p><strong>You Will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understand Smartsheet’s and execution</li> <li>Perform other duties as assigned</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience carrying a £3M+ annual services bookings quota for Enterprise (&gt;5k employee) customers, frequently closing Professional Services opportunities &gt;£100K</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills including needs analysis discovery, solution positioning, business justification, and proven closing techniques</li> <li>Experience leading effective outbound services pipeline generation motions</li> <li>Eagerness to utilize AI workflows and tooling to scale impact</li> <li>Prior experience working in SaaS</li> <li>Ability to travel, as needed, up to 25%</li> <li>Ability to be in the London office at least 1 day per week, preferably 2-3 days per week</li> <li>BS degree or equivalent</li> <li>Legally eligible to work in the UK on an ongoing basis</li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks &amp; Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Employer-paid Private description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Founded in 2020, unybrands is the next-generation brand accelerator platform built to acquire, integrate, and scale digital-first consumer brands. Headquartered in Miami, with offices in New York, London, Berlin, and Shenzhen, our 240+ team brings deep expertise across e-commerce, brand management, consumer retail, operational scaling, and M&amp;A.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Since inception, we have acquired 30+ brands across Pet Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Supplements, Baby &amp; Juvenile, Garden &amp; Outdoor, Sports &amp; Fitness, and Home &amp; Lifestyle — completing 20+ acquisitions and delivering 16 consecutive quarters of like-for-like organic growth post-integration.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Our competitive advantage lies in a fully integrated operating system purpose-built to transform digital brands into omni-channel category leaders. We believe the next generation of consumer brands will be built differently — and we're building the AI-enabled retail tech platform to help them consolidate and win.</p></div><p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing the entire supply chain process, from supplier coordination and logistics to warehouse operations and Amazon FBA management.&nbsp;</p> <p>This leadership role is responsible for ensuring product availability, reducing operational risks, and driving operational excellence across the category. optimization).</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Inventory &amp; PO Management</span></p> <ul> <li>Lead weekly PO planning, balancing demand, inventory, and working capital.</li> safeguarding service levels.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Logistics &amp; Fulfillment</span></p> <ul> <li>Manage inbound and outbound flows in coordination with 3PLs and supporting teams.</li> <li>Ensure timely, cost-effective movement of goods to warehouses, FBA, and other nodes.</li> <li>Resolve logistics issues quickly and escalate risks with solutions.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement to reduce lead times and end-to-end costs.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Reporting &amp; Analytics</span></p> <ul> <li>Deliver weekly updates   • Act as the key point of contact for client tax queries, escalating complex matters where needed

This is a hands-on technical role with a strategic edge, sitting within the Operations Team and working closely with the Director of Operations to turn business problems into HubSpot solutions, and HubSpot capability into business opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

Technical delivery

  • Design, build and maintain custom code on HubSpot (workflow actions, serverless functions, custom objects) and API-based integrations with third-party systems (e.g. identity verification, Companies House, billing)

  • Own technical delivery of HubSpot projects end to end — scoping, build, testing, deployment

  • Build and maintain integrations with other tools in the stack, ensuring data integrity and reliable sync

  • Troubleshoot HubSpot workflows, automations and integrations, liaising with vendors and developers as needed

  • Document all custom builds so solutions remain supportable beyond the original developer

Strategy & capability planning

  • Maintain current knowledge of HubSpot's feature set across all Hubs and licensing tiers, including new/beta features

  • Translate platform capability into practical opportunity, identifying where HubSpot can replace manual process or unlock new functionality

  • Feed technical input into the HubSpot roadmap and advise on build vs. buy vs. configure decisions

  • Track the wider HubSpot ecosystem (App Marketplace, partner integrations, AI features) and flag relevant developments

Collaboration & leadership

  • Partner with the Director of Operations to align technical builds with the CI Programme and business priorities

  • Act as the technical point of contact for HubSpot across Customer Service, Compliance, CoSec, Retention and Outbound Sales

  • Manage relationships with HubSpot and third-party development vendors, including scoping and reviewing delivery

  • Mentor and direct junior technical/CRM resource as the role grows

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience building custom code on HubSpot (custom coded actions, serverless functions) and working with the HubSpot API

  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot CRM across multiple Hubs, including workflows, automation, custom objects and reporting

  • Experience integrating HubSpot with third-party systems via API or middleware

  • Comfortable working independently to scope and deliver technical solutions, while keeping non-technical stakeholders informed in plain language

  • Strong analytical mindset: able to assess a business problem and judge the right technical or platform-led solution

  • HubSpot certifications (e.g. CMS for Developers, Platform Consulting)

  • Experience in a regulated, compliance-heavy, or operations-led environment

  • Familiarity with identity verification or KYC tooling (e.g. Onfido)

  • Exposure to Lean / continuous improvement methodology

raw.description:
About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

  • £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

  • Over 1 million companies formed

  • Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

  • Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

We're looking for a part-qualified or qualified accountant with specialist tax knowledge to join our Accountancy-as-a-Service team. This role is primarily focused on providing expert tax advice and support across our client portfolio, with the added flexibility to step in and cover small business and startup advisory queries when needed. You'll work closely with our accountancy delivery team to ensure clients receive accurate, technically sound tax guidance, while also being able to support broader small business needs as they arise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the specialist tax lead for a portfolio of SME and startup clients, covering corporation tax, VAT, and personal tax as relevant to owner-managed businesses

  • Review and support the preparation of tax computations and returns, ensuring accuracy and compliance with current legislation

  • Identify tax planning opportunities and efficiencies for clients, particularly around business structuring, reliefs, and allowances relevant to small businesses and startups

  • Act as the key point of contact for client tax queries, escalating complex matters where needed

  • Provide cover for small business and startup advisory queries when the primary advisor is unavailable, including guidance on company formation considerations, accounting setup, and early-stage financial best practice

  • Stay current on changes to UK tax legislation and proactively flag relevant updates or risks to clients and the wider team

  • Collaborate with the accountancy service delivery team to ensure tax considerations are built into day-to-day client account management

  • Support onboarding of new clients, advising on the most appropriate tax structure for their circumstances

  • Help develop internal guidance, templates, or resources to support consistent tax advice across the AaaS team

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, or client education around tax compliance

What We Are Looking For

  • Part-qualified or qualified accountants (ACA, ACCA, CTA, or ATT) with specialist tax knowledge

  • Proven experience advising SME, startup, or owner-managed business clients, ideally within an accountancy practice or accountancy-as-a-service environment

  • Strong technical knowledge of UK corporation tax, VAT, and personal tax as it applies to small businesses

  • Comfortable providing broader small business/startup advice as needed, even outside core tax specialism — able to cover this ground confidently when required

  • Confident communicator, able to translate technical tax concepts into clear, practical advice for non-specialist clients

  • Comfortable working with accounting/tax software (e.g. Xero, Sage) and confident using Excel/Google Sheets for reporting and analysis

  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple client relationships and competing priorities

  • A collaborative, client-first mindset, comfortable working cross-functionally within a scaling business

What We Offer

  • £55-60k and comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid working model

  • Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

  • The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

  • A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation: £55K – £60K
